reports.title: SM Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: •SM lowered its full-year 2026 oil production guidance by 1% to 220-222 MBbl/d, primarily related to reasons outlined above. For full-year 2026, total production guidance was narrowed to 420-422 MBoe/d. Full-year capital expenditures are expected to be approximately $2.75 billion, or the midpoint of the prior guidance range.
•Fourth quarter 2026 production is expected to be 435-445 MBoe/d, including 229-239 MBbl/d of oil, with capital expenditures of approximately $610 million.
•Included in our oil volume guidance is a continued impact from takeaway constraints in the Uinta Basin.
•Full-year 2026 cash tax guidance is updated to approximately $100-$120 million.
•See the table below for detailed fourth quarter and full-year guidance.
The following table summarizes SM’s fourth quarter and full-year 2026 operational and financial guidance.
